card.name: Several factors combining to cause result
card.fires_on: The verb or word right after a list of several separate factors, such as "combine", "combined", "together" or "to", where the factors jointly produce an outcome. It is general web prose, not drug-label text.

modes.label: Combine verbs after a list
modes.description: Verb like combine or combined follows a list of subjects that jointly cause an effect.
modes.example: Efficient transportation, technological advances in both farming and factory work, and advances in communication have all<< combined>> to make the use of forced labor very

modes.label: Together as joint adverb
modes.description: The word together or Together marks that earlier items act jointly.
modes.example: Neurology and technology<< together>> impact the teen brain in ways we are

modes.label: Linking word before result
modes.description: A small word such as to or for after joined factors leads into the outcome they produce.
modes.example: Environmental conditions, social conditions and individual actors collide<< to>> spark world-changing ideas.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like together and resulting, which express joint action and outcome.
card.plain: It lights up when several things are named and the text is about to say that they work together to produce an effect.
